lines.en: Each step sinks the ground.

lines.zh: 树顶到我腰，前面是空地。
lines.en: Treetops at my waist; a clearing ahead.
One step of mine, and the whole forest gives way.

lines.zh: 我这一声，五百米外都听得见。
lines.en: My scream carries five hundred meters.

lines.zh: 我高过树顶，看得见你在哪。
lines.en: Taller than the trees, I see where you are.
These trees underfoot feel like grass.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，五百米外都听见。
lines.en: One scream of mine carries five hundred meters.

lines.zh: 十五米的身子，枝杈有点沉。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall, and the branches drag.
Moonlight is left; I will step that way.
That bird five hundred meters out is loud.
Fifteen meters tall, the water is over there.
The trees don't reach my shoulders.
The treetops reach my waist.

lines.zh: 十五米高，低头才看见你。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall — I must look down to find you.

lines.zh: 满月那晚的雷，还在我背上。
lines.en: The lightning of that full moon still clings to my back.
I stand taller than the whole forest.
I stand still, and birds take me for a tree.

lines.zh: 三个月亮，够我逛完这片林。
lines.en: Three moons are enough to walk this forest.
That scream five hundred meters out is me.
Fifteen meters tall. Trees reach my waist.

lines.zh: 我的皮太白了，月光都嫌。
lines.en: My skin is so pale the moonlight flinches.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过整片林间空地。
lines.en: One stride clears the whole clearing.
Fifteen meters tall, taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 月亮数到第三个，我就走。
lines.en: When the moon counts three, I leave.

lines.zh: 两百米外，一只兔子在抖。
lines.en: Two hundred meters out, a rabbit trembles.
A cloud drifts past my shoulder.
The mouth on my head yawns.

lines.zh: 我高过树梢，慢慢蹲下来。
lines.en: I stand above the treetops; I crouch down.

lines.zh: 十五米高，我高过这片林子。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall. I tower over this forest.

lines.zh: 我十五米高，树只到我腰。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall; trees reach my waist.
You smell of sweat and rust.
Is that a living thing under the trees?

lines.zh: 你手里那点亮，我看得清。
lines.en: That little light in your hand — I see it clearly.
Standing that far off — afraid I'll look down?
I see you from two hundred meters.
Fifteen meters tall, I flatten trees.
My scream carries five hundred meters.
I remember the branch you snapped.

lines.zh: 你只有两只眼睛，我有两张嘴。
lines.en: You have two eyes; I have two mouths.
So small — you came to chop trees?
So you're the one Mega John mentioned.
You look so small, tilting your head up.

lines.zh: 隔着两百米，我听见你牙齿。
lines.en: Two hundred meters away, I hear your teeth.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也敢看我。
lines.en: So small a thing, and it dares look at me.
You smell of iron, and of fear.

lines.zh: 这点伤，三只月亮就长好。
lines.en: Three moons will heal this.
Pale skin, but not soft.
You struck my second mouth.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫，五百米外也听见。
lines.en: My scream carries five hundred meters.
Pain runs from my crown to my soles.
Even this big, I can hurt.
The full moon stretched me into this.
A little moss falls; no matter.
Fifteen meters tall — I rattle the trees.

lines.zh: 三个月亮之后，我才会走。
lines.en: I leave only after three moons.
Toss it here; I needn't bend.
Come closer; I can't bow my head.

lines.zh: 你手里那株，往上递一点。
lines.en: Lift that sapling up to me.
Is that what you raise for me?

lines.zh: 你手里的，够我舔一口吗。
lines.en: Is what you hold enough for one lick?

lines.zh: 十五米高，树顶只到我腰。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall; treetops reach my waist.
Leave that morsel at my feet.

lines.zh: 十五米高，也就低头看看你。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall, I just look down at you.
So small a morsel — barely a tooth's gap.

lines.zh: 十五米高的影子压下来。
lines.en: A fifteen-meter shadow bears down.
You hit me. My feet didn't move.

lines.zh: 我十五米高，撞你一下就够了。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall; one bump is enough.

lines.zh: 站稳，我身上的苔还在掉。
lines.en: Steady — the moss is still falling off me.
It doesn't hurt, it is just rude.
My foot lands, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 十五米高，树木都在我腰下。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall — trees reach my waist.
You hit me and even the trees shake.
You walked into my ankle.

lines.zh: 我低下头，整片林子都在动。
lines.en: I lower my head and the whole forest moves.

lines.zh: 你踩的是我的影子，别怕。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow. Don't fear.

lines.zh: 你愿意做我根下的土吗。
lines.en: Would you be the soil beneath my roots?
Three moons are time enough to keep company.
I bend my highest branch down to you.

lines.zh: 十五米高，够看整片森林。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall — I see the whole forest.
Next full moon, be here.

lines.zh: 风会替我把花粉带过去。
lines.en: The wind will carry the pollen for me.
Three screams. You can hear them, right?
Does looking up mean yes?
The moon is overhead; don't leave.

lines.zh: 把你的名字刻进我的树皮。
lines.en: Carve your name into my bark.
Whatever falls into my shadow is mine.

lines.zh: 弯下十五米，才够到你脚边。
lines.en: Fifteen meters down to reach your feet.

lines.zh: 我十五米高，树只到我腰
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall

lines.zh: 十五米高，我得弯下整个身子。
lines.en: Fifteen metres tall — I must bend my whole body.

lines.zh: 掉在我脚边的，就是我的。
lines.en: What falls at my feet is mine.
Pick it up, and it's mine underfoot.
This isn't even a mouthful.
A stone this small — a toy in my palm.
Two fingers are enough for this.

lines.zh: 我比这片林子还高两头。
lines.en: I stand two heads above this whole forest.
Locked on you. No hurry.
You're dead center in my sight.

lines.zh: 五百米外，我的叫声就到了。
lines.en: My scream reaches five hundred meters.

lines.zh: 两百米外我就看见你了。
lines.en: I saw you from two hundred meters off.

lines.zh: 十五米高，森林都在我脚下。
lines.en: Fifteen meters tall, with the forest under me.
The mouth on my head moves first.
Every treetop leans your way.
In the light, you can't hide.
Long since I looked down at anyone.

lines.zh: 两百米，你跑不出我的眼。
lines.en: Two hundred meters — you can't outrun my sight.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，五百米外都听得见。
lines.en: My scream carries five hundred meters.
After three moons, I leave.
Don't hide — my shadow is too wide.
Don't stop; I want a few more steps.
I hear you from five hundred meters.

lines.zh: 影子一直跟着你，慢但不停。
lines.en: My shadow follows you, slow but never stopping.

lines.zh: 你的脚印，我低头就看见。
lines.en: I look down and see your footprints.
Are the branches blocking your way?
Run; one step of mine is ten of yours.
My roots reach the corner before you.

lines.zh: 两百米外，我也看得见你。
lines.en: At two hundred metres, I still see you.

lines.zh: 我一声叫，五百米外都听见。
lines.en: One cry of mine carries five hundred meters.

lines.zh: 雷霆把我变成这样，你也试试。
lines.en: Lightning made me this; try it.
The tree you cut was taller than you.
Don't run. Just one bite.
Two mouths, and you only fill one.
Bones crack louder than branches.

lines.zh: 一张嘴咬头，一张咬躯干。
lines.en: One mouth takes the head, one the trunk.
I knocked down a row of trees.

lines.zh: 接我这一枝，森林挡不住我！
lines.en: Take this branch; no forest stops me!
My mouth is longer than the trees.
Behind that tree — I see you.

lines.zh: 满月那一下，把我撑大了。
lines.en: The full moon struck and stretched me huge.
That lightning planted me here.
I have grown out of the forest.
When I woke, the birds had all fled.

lines.zh: 第一次站起来，树都矮了。
lines.en: Standing for the first time, the trees shrank.

lines.zh: 我这一声，五百米外都听见。
lines.en: My cry is heard five hundred meters away.

lines.zh: 满月的光，把我从土里拉出来。
lines.en: The full moon pulled me out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我一叫，五百米外都听见。
lines.en: One cry carries five hundred meters.

lines.zh: 十五米，站起来先撞断树。
lines.en: Fifteen meters — I stand up through trees.
This wood is too small to hold me.
The full-moon lightning struck me again.
The bolt struck. I grew.
Slept too long, my joints are stiff.

lines.zh: 我醒了，整片林子也该醒。
lines.en: I am awake, and the whole wood should be.

lines.zh: 火？我这张脸可没打算烧。
lines.en: Fire? I don't plan to burn this face.
I fell and crushed a row of trees.

lines.zh: 水只到我膝盖，可我沉了。
lines.en: Water only to my knees, yet I sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡，两张嘴都麻。
lines.en: The blast rings in my ears; both mouths go numb.
This arrow itches worse than a bug bite.

lines.zh: 魔法？我身上的苔在发光。
lines.en: Magic? The moss on me glows.
Hungry enough to swallow a cow whole.
The lightning stretched me taller still.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我这十五米也没处站。
lines.en: In the void, even fifteen meters has nowhere to stand.
